Recurring Sales Quote

Create sales quotes that repeat on a regular schedule.

Useful for regular pricing updates or periodic service quotations.

Next issue date

The date when the next sales quote will be automatically created. This date advances automatically based on the interval and period type after each quote is generated.

Expiry date

The number of days the quote remains valid before expiring. This sets the expiry date for each generated quote.

Interval

The frequency interval for creating quotes. For example, enter 3 with 'Months' period type to create quotes every 3 months (quarterly).

PeriodType

The period type that works with the interval to determine frequency. Choose from Days, Weeks, Months, or Years.

MonthDay

For monthly recurring quotes, specify which day of the month the quote should be created.

ExpirationType

Determines when the recurring schedule ends. Choose 'Until further notice' for ongoing quotes or 'Until date' to stop on a specific date.

UntilDate

The date when recurring quotes will stop being created. Only applicable when expiration type is set to 'Until date'.

Customer

Select the customer for whom these recurring quotes will be created. All generated quotes will be for this customer.

Billing address

The billing address for the customer. This will be copied to each generated quote.

Description

A description that identifies this recurring quote template and will be copied to each generated quote.

Lines

The quote lines specifying items, quantities, and prices. Each generated quote will include these lines.

Automatic reference

When enabled, automatically generates unique reference numbers for each created quote. Disable to use custom reference numbers.
